subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Infotainment Systems
description: A micro-lesson that makes Infotainment Systems usable.

hook.text: A car's center screen now runs more software than the entire Apollo 11 spacecraft.

buildup.text: Infotainment handles navigation, music, phone calls, climate control, and vehicle settings.

discovery.text: Apple CarPlay and Android Auto let your phone's apps mirror onto the car's display seamlessly.

twist.text: Some automakers are removing physical buttons entirely—forcing everything through touchscreens.

climax.text: That's sparking backlash. Drivers say touchscreens are distracting and harder to use while driving.

punchline.text: More screen doesn't always mean better driving.

quiz.question: Why are some drivers unhappy with touchscreen-only controls?
